svg.title: jet_quenching.svg
svg.desc: 全矢量图：文字为可编辑的真 text 元素，平滑渐变为真 gradient（不是色阶台阶），其余为逐像素临摹的色块矢量。图层 = 面板(panel) -> 物理元素(element) -> path；每个面板另有 text 子层。元素命名见 panels.py 的 ELEMENTS 表。

g.data-label: Jet quenching: a back-to-back dijet produced inside a vertically elongated QGP medium. The right-going jet exits almost immediately (short path, unquenched); the left-going jet traverses nearly the whole medium, losing energy by gluon bremsstrahlung (quenched, fewer/softer hadrons)
g.title: Jet quenching: a back-to-back dijet produced inside a vertically elongated QGP medium. The right-going jet exits almost immediately (short path, unquenched); the left-going jet traverses nearly the whole medium, losing energy by gluon bremsstrahlung (quenched, fewer/softer hadrons)
g.desc: Jet quenching: a back-to-back dijet produced inside a vertically elongated QGP medium. The right-going jet exits almost immediately (short path, unquenched); the left-going jet traverses nearly the whole medium, losing energy by gluon bremsstrahlung (quenched, fewer/softer hadrons)

g.data-label: QGP medium: vertically elongated semi-transparent ellipsoid (long axis = beam direction, vertical)
g.inkscape:label: QGP medium: vertically elongated semi-transparent ellipsoid (long axis = beam direction, vertical)
g.title: QGP medium: vertically elongated semi-transparent ellipsoid (long axis = beam direction, vertical)

g.data-label: Hard-scattering starburst (bright yellow-white) at the dijet origin
g.inkscape:label: Hard-scattering starburst (bright yellow-white) at the dijet origin
g.title: Hard-scattering starburst (bright yellow-white) at the dijet origin

g.data-label: Unquenched jet: collimated cone going up-right. Short path -- it leaves the medium almost immediately, so it stays bright and saturated
g.inkscape:label: Unquenched jet: collimated cone going up-right. Short path -- it leaves the medium almost immediately, so it stays bright and saturated
g.title: Unquenched jet: collimated cone going up-right. Short path -- it leaves the medium almost immediately, so it stays bright and saturated

g.data-label: Hadron cluster at the tip of the unquenched jet (many, bright, light blue)
g.inkscape:label: Hadron cluster at the tip of the unquenched jet (many, bright, light blue)
g.title: Hadron cluster at the tip of the unquenched jet (many, bright, light blue)

g.data-label: Quenched jet: cone going down-left. Long path -- it traverses nearly the whole medium, so it is desaturated, grey-blue and fades out
g.inkscape:label: Quenched jet: cone going down-left. Long path -- it traverses nearly the whole medium, so it is desaturated, grey-blue and fades out
g.title: Quenched jet: cone going down-left. Long path -- it traverses nearly the whole medium, so it is desaturated, grey-blue and fades out

g.data-label: Hadron cluster at the tip of the quenched jet (only 2-3, darker, grey)
g.inkscape:label: Hadron cluster at the tip of the quenched jet (only 2-3, darker, grey)
g.title: Hadron cluster at the tip of the quenched jet (only 2-3, darker, grey)

g.data-label: Gluon bremsstrahlung: small yellow-green dots and swirls along the quenched jet, only inside the medium (this is the energy-loss mechanism)
g.inkscape:label: Gluon bremsstrahlung: small yellow-green dots and swirls along the quenched jet, only inside the medium (this is the energy-loss mechanism)
g.title: Gluon bremsstrahlung: small yellow-green dots and swirls along the quenched jet, only inside the medium (this is the energy-loss mechanism)

g.data-label: Beam direction: short vertical double-headed arrow in the gap right of the medium
g.inkscape:label: Beam direction: short vertical double-headed arrow in the gap right of the medium
g.title: Beam direction: short vertical double-headed arrow in the gap right of the medium
